critique: The turquoise-on-black palette and the centered radial emission are on intent. Motion is clearly explosive, but it overshoots: by 1.9s nearly all particles have traveled beyond the frame, leaving only sparse corner fragments rather than a readable expanding ring. At 0.08s the burst is an overly dense, smooth concentric bullseye with little separation between particles. The preset needs a slower, more legible expanding particle ring with brighter individual dots retained inside frame.

suggestions.why: Reduce radial velocity so the expanding ring remains visibly within the composition at 1.9s instead of exiting to the corners.
Lower the initial burst density so the early frame breaks into individually readable particles rather than opaque concentric bands.
Increase particle opacity so the slower, more dispersed ring remains bright and energetic against black at later time.
